verdict.rationale: Belvo publishes an OpenAPI-based API reference covering its product endpoints. A hands-on community report describes clicking "Run" next to script snippets in the docs, which shows runnable examples. A first-party Postman collection and a sandbox are also offered. However, the community report is dated, nothing documents a current try-it console inside the API reference itself, and the probed OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404. missing for 10: current documentation of an in-reference interactive try-it console, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, recent independent corroboration of runnable in-docs examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: clicking "Run" next to each script snippet takes 2-3 seconds
